issue.title: just symvision red: 11 unused public plan decision-card symbols in plan_decision_cards.py and plan_decision_rows.py

task_type_fields.node_id: just symvision (lint (symvision) stage of just check)
task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
`just symvision` (the lint (symvision) stage of `just check`) is deterministic static
analysis: the same tree always gives the same result. On master 101c853939 it reports 11
unused public symbols in the Plan Review decision-card modules. Each has only an in-file
caller or only test references, and test references never count for Symvision.

- src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plan_decision_cards.py: OptionLineMap, DecisionCard,
  answer_chip_text, default_line_text, unverified_preview (648ef1a390, sase-1ka.1);
  is_unverified_row, memory_type_chips, unverified_warning_line (moved into this new
  file by 648ef1a390; they came from sase-1hi.6 edb0120aec, sase-1hi.5 124c4cffa8, and
  117f4cebbc)
- src/sase/ace/tui/modals/plan_decision_rows.py: DecisionDensity, DecisionSlot,
  decide_decision_density (e21669907c, sase-1ka.2); DecisionCard is also referenced here

These were hidden while symvision exited early on the _load_archive_bundle
private-import error. That is the same masking pattern as sase-1hp. b249bc5e69 removed
that private import, and sase-1ka's land check only ever saw the private item.
sase-1ka is closed.

Fix per the symvision policy: privatize symbols used only in their own file (update the
tests to use the public surface), delete truly dead ones along with their tests, and
re-run `just symvision`.

Repro: `just symvision`

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1jm land agent found these when symvision stopped exiting early on the private-import rule; the owning epic sase-1ka is closed, so no active epic absorbs them.
